verdict.rationale: Teams' general call/meeting feature set is claimed in docs-18, and community hands-on reports (comm-4, comm-19) confirm screen sharing/annotation exists but describe it as slow to enable, bloated ('takes a screenshot... starts a whiteboard session... takes a good 30 seconds'), and outright disabled on some browsers (Firefox ESR) due to poor detection. This shows the capability is real but delivered with significant friction rather than smoothly. Missing for 10: first-party documentation specifically describing the screen-share feature/UX, and independent verification that it works reliably across clients without the described bugs.
